baseline.method: Same signed-in in-app browser; one excluded warmup, six measured sequential GET /categories; at least one second between request starts; no-store; no retries. Wire and normalized hashes checked without exporting body or credentials. Small sequential cohort, no reliable p95 or causal app-wide estimate.

preflight.scope: Same production experiment, maximum 48 owned application GETs and identity reads including the historical cohort and conservative setup reservations; CORS preflights are recorded separately; cumulative ceiling 100,000 reads and 5,000 writes. Preserve 2.5 million reads and 50,000 writes. No provisioning.
